name: acme-staging-external
goal: Authorized security assessment of ACME's staging web perimeter. Identify and verify vulnerabilities reachable from the listed hosts: authentication flaws, injection, access-control gaps, and exposed sensitive functionality. Record each issue as a finding with evidence and reproduction steps.

scope.rules_of_engagement: Testing window: business hours only. No denial-of-service or load testing. No social engineering. No changes to production data. Stop and report if you reach anything that looks like real customer PII.
